sdrlDeliverables.title: General Arrangement / Layout Drawings

sdrlDeliverables.postAwardRule: POST-AWARD (FULL): Complete IFC General Arrangement & Mounting Detail drawings per platform.
sdrlDeliverables.crossVolumeGate: §10 R1/R2 — Physical footprint & tower elevation locked to 11.C1 Rittal/Tower BOM

sdrlDeliverables.title: Schematic Diagrams
sdrlDeliverables.withBidRule: WITH BID (SAMPLE): Block/Single-Line Diagram per Telecom system bound to Appendix 2 LIS-0001 tags.
sdrlDeliverables.postAwardRule: POST-AWARD (FULL): Full interconnection wiring, patch-panel, and termination schematics.
sdrlDeliverables.crossVolumeGate: §10 R1/R2 — Schematic tag count & port topology reconciled with 11.C1 & 10.2 SI

sdrlDeliverables.title: Equipment Data Sheets (DTS)
sdrlDeliverables.withBidRule: WITH BID (FULL): 4-page A4 Datasheet (12.T) per system/area locked to Volume I 11.C1 AS-IS models & 7 VND catalogs.
sdrlDeliverables.postAwardRule: POST-AWARD (AFC/AS-BUILT): Final vendor-certified DTS incorporating PTTEP review comments.
sdrlDeliverables.crossVolumeGate: §10 R1/R3 — Gate R1 forbids COMPLY on OPEN/TBE; Gate R3 routes DEVIATE to Tab 14 Deviation List

sdrlDeliverables.title: Catalogues & Brochures (VDB)
sdrlDeliverables.withBidRule: WITH BID (FULL): Manufacturer datasheets & cut-sheets for every offered equipment item E* in 11.C1.
sdrlDeliverables.postAwardRule: POST-AWARD (FINAL VDB): Complete indexed Vendor Data Book with ATEX/IECEx & PTD certificates.
sdrlDeliverables.crossVolumeGate: §10 R1 — Every K_Cat(E*) entry must match 7 VND offer evidence and 11.C1 Part No.

sdrlDeliverables.title: Link Budget Calculations
sdrlDeliverables.withBidRule: WITH BID (MEMORY BASELINE): Preliminary RF pathloss / availability & power/heat calculation from STU-0002 + K_RF(E*).
sdrlDeliverables.postAwardRule: POST-AWARD (FULL): Full site-surveyed path calculation, antenna height optimization & PTD frequency filing.
sdrlDeliverables.crossVolumeGate: §10 R2 — RF parameters (Tx power, Rx threshold, dish gain) locked to 12.T Datasheet

sdrlDeliverables.title: Inspection & Test Plan (ITP)
sdrlDeliverables.withBidRule: WITH BID (STATEMENT): Inspection & Test Plan statement covering OEM FAT, Thailand Pre-FAT/iFAT, and offshore SAT.
sdrlDeliverables.postAwardRule: POST-AWARD (FULL): Detailed witnessed FAT/iFAT/SAT test procedures & hold/witness point matrix.
sdrlDeliverables.crossVolumeGate: §10 R2 — FAT/iFAT/SAT scope aligned with Working B4/C7 & A1 S/N 2

phiDtsEquation.name: DTS AS-IS Specification Mapping Equation (Φ_DTS(r))
phiDtsEquation.formula: Φ_DTS(r) = (C1: No., C2: Parameter, C3: COMPANY Requirement) × K_Cat(E*) → (Vendor Offered Data, Compliance Status, Remarks); Model_DTS(s, l, Tag) ≡ Model_Vol.I(11.C1)(s, l, Tag)

outcomes.customerBehavior: Display exact catalog value & COMPLY badge

outcomes.condition: C3(r) specifies VTA / Defined by the bidder and exact value of E* is populated
outcomes.customerBehavior: Display exact populated E* value & COMPLY (VTA) badge

outcomes.condition: Minor variance under AS-IS Volume I model (e.g., IP-50CX channel spacing or All-Outdoor port layout via cabinet switch)
outcomes.customerBehavior: Display offered data + explicit technical explanation in Remarks

outcomes.condition: Missing in catalog K_Cat(E*) — Gate R1 forbids COMPLY

outcomes.internalBehavior: Auto-link to Tab 14 Deviation List (Gate R3)
